subject.title: fix(cli): cap config patch file input

question: Should `openclaw config patch --file` begin rejecting otherwise valid patch files above 1 MiB to match the existing `--stdin` limit?
rationale: The implementation is small, but this changes an existing CLI workflow from accepting arbitrary file sizes to failing before parsing or validation; current code establishes the stdin limit, not a documented file-input limit.

options.title: Adopt file/stdin parity
options.body: Accept the 1 MiB file limit as the config-patch CLI contract after restoring the existing missing-file diagnostic.

options.title: Keep file input uncapped
options.body: Reject this behavior change and retain the current file-input compatibility until a separately designed limit or migration policy exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt file/stdin parity
recommendation.body: Accept the 1 MiB file limit as the config-patch CLI contract after restoring the existing missing-file diagnostic.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete current-main owner could not be established from the available read-only history evidence; the decision belongs with the owner of the config CLI contract.
